svg.content:
<mxfile host="drawio">
 <diagram id="arch" name="How it works">
 <mxGraphModel grid="0" page="0" background="#FFFFFF" math="0" shadow="0">
 <root>
 <mxCell id="0"/>
 <mxCell id="1" parent="0"/>
 <mxCell id="client" value="<b>MCP client</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">local or cloud model</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontSize=13;arcSize=20;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="330" y="20" width="240" height="56" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="mcp" value="<b>mcp_server/</b>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=13;arcSize=8;verticalAlign=top;align=center;spacingTop=4;container=1;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="40" y="120" width="820" height="96" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="rt" value="<b>read tools</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">summary, trends, timeline, sql_query</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;arcSize=20;" vertex="1" parent="mcp">
 <mxGeometry x="40" y="34" width="250" height="48" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="wt" value="<b>write tools</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">stage, map, approve, log_meal</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=12;arcSize=20;" vertex="1" parent="mcp">
 <mxGeometry x="530" y="34" width="250" height="48" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="views" value="<b>approved views</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">read-only role · 5 s timeout · row limits</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;arcSize=20;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="40" y="262" width="320" height="60" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="core" value="<b>core/services</b>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff8ef;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=12;arcSize=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=2;container=1;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="420" y="252" width="440" height="80" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="p1" value="normalize" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=11;arcSize=30;" vertex="1" parent="core">
 <mxGeometry x="14" y="30" width="82" height="36" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="p2" value="status" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=11;arcSize=30;" vertex="1" parent="core">
 <mxGeometry x="120" y="30" width="82" height="36" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="p3" value="critical rules" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;arcSize=30;" vertex="1" parent="core">
 <mxGeometry x="226" y="30" width="90" height="36" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="p4" value="<b>pending</b>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=11;arcSize=30;" vertex="1" parent="core">
 <mxGeometry x="340" y="30" width="86" height="36" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="an" value="<b>analytics/</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">trends, baselines, calculators,<br>screening, nutrition, weekly report</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=12;arcSize=16;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="40" y="380" width="250" height="70" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="sf" value="<b>safety/</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">critical values, narrative flags,<br>interactions, crisis, alerts</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;arcSize=16;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="610" y="380" width="250" height="70" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="db" value="<b>PostgreSQL 16</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">+ pgvector</font>" style="shape=cylinder3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;boundedLbl=1;size=12;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=13;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="340" y="490" width="220" height="90" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="ing" value="<b>ingestion/ · scripts/</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">Apple Health, Garmin, embeddings</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=12;arcSize=20;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="610" y="505" width="250" height="60" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e1" value="stdio" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;startArrow=block;startFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" edge="1" parent="1" source="client" target="mcp">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e2" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" edge="1" parent="1" source="rt" target="views">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e3" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#d79b00;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" edge="1" parent="1" source="wt" target="core">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="c1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#d79b00;endSize=4;" edge="1" parent="core" source="p1" target="p2">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="c2" style="html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#d79b00;endSize=4;" edge="1" parent="core" source="p2" target="p3">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="c3" style="html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#d79b00;endSize=4;" edge="1" parent="core" source="p3" target="p4">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e4" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#b85450;dashed=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.3;entryY=0;" edge="1" parent="1" source="p3" target="sf">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e5" value="computed over<br>approved data" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#9673a6;dashed=1;fontSize=10;fontColor=#9673a6;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0.4;exitY=1;entryX=0.52;entryY=0;" edge="1" parent="1" source="views" target="an">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e6" value="SELECT" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;startArrow=none;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=10;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0.94;exitY=1;entryX=0.09;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" edge="1" parent="1" source="views" target="db">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e7" value="INSERT pending" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#d79b00;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=10;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0.15;exitY=1;entryX=0.91;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" edge="1" parent="1" source="core" target="db">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e8" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0;exitY=0.5;entryX=1;entryY=0.5;" edge="1" parent="1" source="ing" target="db">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 </root>
 </mxGraphModel>
 </diagram>
</mxfile>
